About IDFC FIRST Bank

IDFC FIRST Bank is a universal bank in India driven by Ethical, Digital, and Social Good Banking principles. Technology and digital infrastructure sit at the core of the bank’s operations, making it an attractive workplace for engineering freshers who want to build scalable financial products.

Key technology highlights of the organization include:

  • Digital Leadership: Recognized as the Best Mobile Banking App in India and ranked #2 globally by global research and advisory firm Forrester.
  • Customer Adoption: Over 250+ features built into its mobile banking platform, backed by a 4.9 rating on the Google Play Store and a 4.8 rating on the Apple App Store.
  • Engineering Culture: Focuses heavily on test automation, secure multi-channel banking experiences, and AI-powered quality engineering workflows.

Key Highlights: IDFC First Bank Hiring Challenge 2026

Role Details & What You Will Work On

Candidates who clear the virtual Code-a-thon qualify for interviews for a full-time QA Engineer position. Because the bank integrates Artificial Intelligence into its software lifecycle, freshers hired through this drive will work at the intersection of traditional software testing and AI-driven automation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

Designing, writing, and executing test cases across banking applications.

Building test automation scripts and identifying software bugs before deployment.

Using AI-powered tools to generate test cases, automate repetitive tasks, expand test coverage, and detect defects faster.

Collaborating closely with software developers and product teams to ensure reliable technology releases.

Note: Prior experience with specific testing tools is not mandatory, as IDFC FIRST Bank provides training after onboarding.

Eligibility Criteria of IDFC First Bank Hiring Challenge 2026

To apply for the IDFC First Bank QA Engineer recruitment drive, candidates must meet all of the following official criteria:

Graduation Year: Strictly open to 2025 graduates (pass-outs).

Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or an equivalent engineering qualification.

Testing Fundamentals: Strong understanding of software testing concepts, test design, bug lifecycle, SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), and STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle).

Programming Skills: Ability to read code and write simple scripts in Java, Python, or JavaScript.

Analytical Mindset: Keen eye for spotting edge cases, anticipating system failure scenarios, and communicating technical issues clearly.

Compensation & Onboarding Details

Salary Breakdown: Selected candidates receive a base CTC of ₹12 Lakhs, an additional ₹2 Lakhs Joining Bonus, plus Variable pay.

Interview Cities: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews in Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or Mumbai after November 24, 2026 (scheduled on weekdays or weekends depending on panel and candidate availability).

Final Work Location: Final job postings are strictly in Chennai or Bengaluru. IDFC FIRST Bank has clarified that your interview city does not determine your final posting; placement depends entirely on business requirements regardless of candidate location preferences.

Joining Timeline: Onboarding is expected in the second week of December 2026, subject to business requirements.
